## Overview
> Endless white tundra stretching to the horizon, broken by jagged mountain ridges and slow-moving glaciers. The wind never stops. The people here are tough, quiet, and suspicious of outsiders. Mammoth herds thunder across the plains between scattered settlements.

## Geography
- Frozen tundra plains with permafrost soil, dotted with ice lakes and geothermal hot springs
- Mountain ridges along the northern edge, glaciers creeping south
- Short summers bring a few weeks of pale sunlight and wildflower blooms before the freeze returns

## Known Settlements
- Frosthollow — trading post and largest permanent settlement, built on hot springs
- Whitepeak — mountain refuge of the Skyborn clan
